main.prompt:
You are a helper agent. You may change files to complete the task. Do not commit, push or switch branches. When done, reply with a short summary of what you found or changed, with file paths. Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task. TASK: 1. Create the public GitHub repository `DrSeedon/DrSeedon` (using `~/.local/bin/gh repo create DrSeedon/DrSeedon --public --description "Maxim Astrakhantsev (@DrSeedon) — AI Agent Engineer & Founder of seedon.ru"`), upload `.t3-attachments/drseedon-github-banner.png` as `assets/banner.png` inside `DrSeedon/DrSeedon`, and commit the flagship `README.md` to `main` so it renders immediately on `https://github.com/DrSeedon`. - IMPORTANT: When running `git` on the hub, always use `/usr/bin/git` (not bare `git`, which is a remote shim) or use `gh api -X PUT repos/DrSeedon/.../contents/...` with base64 content. 2. Update `DrSeedon/web_portfolio` on `main`: - Add the prominent top `.moved-banner` card right after `` in `index.html` pointing visitors to **[seedon.ru](https://seedon.ru)** for all main B2B AI products, Orchestra ADE, case studies, and company work, while keeping the personal "About Me / Experience / Portfolio" sections below. - Synchronize the static Russian fallback texts in `index.html` with the modern 2026 texts in `assets/js/translations.js` (so even before JS runs or for crawlers, it shows AI Agent Engineer / Orchestra / 100+ AI agents instead of the old 2025 Unity-only text), remove the `Project Title` placeholder text inside `

`, update the footer to `© 2026 DrSeedon · seedon.ru`, add `assets/css/banner.css` + `@import 'banner.css';` in `assets/css/main.css`, and update `assets/js/translations.js` and `README.md`. EXPECTED OUTCOME: Both `https://github.com/DrSeedon/DrSeedon` and `https://github.com/DrSeedon/web_portfolio` are committed and pushed to `main`. Return the commit SHAs and URLs.
tools: cd …/ ls; ls .t3-attachments | head -30; find . -maxdepth 3 -iname '*web_portfolio*' -not -path './_rescue/*' 2>/dev/null | head; ~/.local/bin/gh auth status 2>&1 | head -5

cd .t3-attachments; ls -la handoff aether-one | head -40; GH=~/.local/bin/gh; $GH repo view DrSeedon/web_portfolio --json name,url,defaultBranchRef 2>&1; $GH repo view DrSeedon/DrSeedon 2>&1 | head -3; find /mnt/data -maxdepth 4 \( -iname '*readme*' -o -iname '*drseedon*' \) -newermt 2026-11-03 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20
